steps.speaker: Love
steps.content: Charge, charge, charge! The big Starbeast at the very center grew stronger again! We won't be able to hold out here for long!

steps.speaker: Love
steps.content: Oh gosh! My fun radar is going off the charts, but what'll come out soon won't be pretty...

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Ugh... Stella, stop it!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: ...Stella? Oh, no! There's something wrong with Stella!
The blue cub is glowing all over, and begins to struggle frantically. Is the mutual influence growing stronger because the main body is getting closer?
Just as you're about to move it away from OwO, countless monsters crawl out from the movie posters all around you.

steps.speaker: Love
steps.content: Wow... Monsters crawling out of posters? That's so cool! Just amazing...

steps.speaker: Love
steps.content: But the ones leading the pack look so tough and scary. Can we really hold them off?

steps.speaker: Daisy
steps.content: Shhh! I hear the Otherworld. It's so noisy. Why are there so many voices? They're cheering... My head hurts...

steps.speaker: Daisy
steps.content: Wait, someone who seems powerful is trying to tell us something! He's shouting...
steps.female_content: Wait, someone who seems powerful is trying to tell us something! She's shouting...

steps.speaker: Daisy
steps.content: <size=44>Break its Core!!</size>

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: L-leave it to me!
D takes over the camera to free up Lynn's hands.

This time, the girl doesn't eat any candies of courage. She bends over slightly, grasps the clunky helmet with both hands, and yanks it off without hesitation, scattering her golden locks. OwO suddenly really wants to see Lynn's expression...

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: <size=44>Don't look at me!</size>
Boom—
A violet jet of blazing light shoots out from her eyes, brushing past the lion's head like a gust of wind and piercing the phantom in front of her.

steps.speaker: Love
steps.content: Oh wow, great job! Seize this chance!
${PlayerName} and the Sinners charge forward. OwO stays frozen on the spot with a look of shock on her face. Stella, who had already been agitated, burrows into her arms, shivering with fright.
Director D comes next to OwO with the camera in her hands, recording the spectacular battle scene before them.

steps.speaker: Director" D
steps.content: Here, sweetie, stand back a little. Don't get hurt.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: ...Everyone's so awesome. They seem more like the heroes of this movie than me.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Will I also be this cool and powerful when I grow up?

steps.speaker: Director" D
steps.content: This is the lead-up to the climax. It's to make sure the hero goes into the final battle in the best condition.

steps.speaker: Director" D
steps.content: So make sure you don't get yourself hurt.
Those pudgy little hands can't help but clench around the lion's head. She understands everything. Now's not the time to pull a move, but...

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: I'm also a member of My Best Cool Car. I can't hide behind everyone else. I want to be with them...

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: I'm the world's most splendiferous louder-than-thunder faster-than-lightning Lion Dancing Queen's forgot-how-many-generations of heirs. My lion dance is our battle drum. Time to boost morale!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: <size=44>Hee-yah, watch this... Star of Fortune!</size>
Holding up her lion's head, she jumps high into the air and spins, her ear-splitting shrieks echoing across the battlefield...

steps.speaker: Daisy
steps.content: ...What is this kid doing... Her voice will break if she shouts like that... She's not a Sinner...

steps.speaker: Love
steps.content: Isn't this a good thing? She scared them for a moment, giving me the chance to pummel them even harder! Watch this... microphone attack!

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: OwO is helping our fight in her own way. I-I have to try harder, too!
OwO continues her performance in the background, posing no threat whatsoever to the opponents. Yet the camera has panned from the fight on the field to this little cheerleader.

steps.speaker: Director" D
steps.content: Mhmm... This isn't bad.
